whatItIs.title: What Canvallax Is
whatItIs.body: Canvallax gives business and technical stakeholders a small set of shared, deliberately incomplete visual canvases, so everyone reads the same system the same way.

issues.title: Issues
issues.body: An Issue bundles all four canvases plus a Backlog into one unit. Pick or switch Issues from the burger menu's "Change Issue".

canvases.title: The Four Canvases
canvases.process: Process — the process itself, and what may change about it.
canvases.system: System — attached systems and their connections, and what may be affected.
canvases.object: Object — data & entities and their relations, and what may differ.
canvases.interaction: Interaction — touchpoints, and how they change.

backlog.title: Backlog
backlog.body: The panel on the left, always visible once an Issue is active — a running list of named entries with descriptions, attached to the whole Issue rather than one canvas.

modes.title: Presenting vs. Editing
modes.body: Toggle in the Backlog panel's footer. Editing opens a canvas's native editor to work in it; Presenting reflows the All grid instead, enlarging one tile at a time for a walkthrough.

copy.title: Copying Across Issues
copy.body: A single view or Backlog entry can be copied in from another Issue — a view overwrites the current one, an entry is appended. A whole Issue is never copied at once.

history.title: History
history.body: Each canvas keeps its own version history. Open History next to Copy/Export to browse and restore an earlier version.

export.title: Export
export.body: Copy or download a canvas in its native format, as SVG, PNG, or PDF, via Export next to Copy/History — or via the small export button on any All-view tile. Menu → Export Issue bundles every canvas as SVG and PNG in one ZIP.
